summary: Lincoln County, MT summit lookout: L-4 cab built 1936, R-6 cab 1962; the Forest Service removed the cab in 2009 (FireLookout.com says 2010).

facts.design: L-4 cab built 1936; replaced in 1962 by an R-6 cab on a 10-foot concrete base
facts.status_note: Cab removed by the Forest Service in 2009 (FireLookout.com says 2010); no source describes what, if anything, remains on the summit today

access.note: Reached by National Forest Trail 649 from Cedar Creek Trail 141; motor vehicles not allowed. No source describes the old summit site or whether it is open to visitors.

visit.trail_note: Scenery Mountain Lookout Trail #649, 5.0 miles, light use, moderate difficulty; a July 2026 trail closure order covered the Scenery Mountain Trail network

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Kootenai National Forest

events.note: L-4 cab, the first structure on the site
R-6 cab atop a 10-foot concrete base replaced the L-4 cab
Forest Service removed the cab from its concrete block foundation, per the register and the 2009 chapter report; FireLookout.com says 2010
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register October 8, 2011

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the 2009 chapter report put the removal in 2009; FireLookout.com says 2010. The story gives 2009 and notes the 2010 date.
A Kootenai National Forest trail listing still describes a lookout that stands and is staffed each summer. That contradicts the removal accounts, so the listing is treated as out of date.

notes_for_editor: Gone status is well supported (FFLA list, FFLOS register, FireLookout.com, and the 2009 chapter report). The removal year disagrees: 2009 (register, chapter report) vs 2010 (FireLookout.com). The visitmt trail listing (data.visitmt.com/data/site/5563) describes a manned lookout on the summit; it looks stale and should be checked with the Kootenai NF before anyone relies on it. Record elevation 2095.8 m has no source in what was read. Record kind two_story matches the FFLA list (2-Story cab); no correction. The brief's access 'unknown' is replaced by trail access only; the old site's access is unverified. No new photos found. The closure was reported in a late-July 2026 Montanian update (URL dated 2026-07-23); its current status was not checked.
